THE_PIONEER.headline: Asset growth through business suits you.
THE_PIONEER.body:
You have the ability to make money with your own ideas. It's better to create the board yourself than to invest in a system someone else made.

This trait shines in startups, new businesses, and personal brands. Conversely, simple day trading doesn't fit your personality.

Your risk is the impulse to bet everything at once. Create a steady cash flow before making big bets.
patterns: You are weak at steady management.
THE_PIONEER.best_reason: Someone who protects the money you earn.
THE_PIONEER.challenging_reason: If both enjoy risk, recovery in a crisis is difficult.
actions: Fix 30% of income as automatic savings.
Invest in installments over 3 months instead of one big bet.
Have a financial manager.
red_flags: Do you not know where your earned money went?
Is your living expense account empty?

THE_ADAPTER.headline: Wealth luck opens when you have various income sources.
THE_ADAPTER.body:
Putting everything in one place increases risk for you. Digging multiple wells is your wealth strategy.

This trait suits side jobs, freelancing, multiple income sources, and small investments. Conversely, betting all assets on one company/asset is dangerous.

The risk is earning a lot but not saving. Just make sure to do one automatic saving.
patterns: You are skilled at creating multiple income sources.
It's hard to focus on one place.
THE_ADAPTER.best_reason: Someone who gathers your scattered income.
THE_ADAPTER.challenging_reason: If both scatter, financial management becomes impossible.
actions: Create one automatic savings account.
Write a monthly income-expense table.
Add expertise to one main income source.
red_flags: Is income high but savings zero?
Is your energy scattered across multiple sources?

THE_RADIATOR.headline: You are the type where honor and wealth come together.
THE_RADIATOR.body:
You make money through people. Connections, reputation, and brand are your assets.

This trait shines in business, sales, and entertainment. Conversely, you are weak at solitary analytical investing.

The risk is spending big when you spend. Automatic savings and spending limits are essential.
patterns: You spend big when you spend.
actions: Automatically save 20% of income.
Set a monthly spending limit.
Decide on big purchases after 24 hours.
red_flags: Is your card bill exceeding your income?
Do you often regret impulse purchases?

THE_KEEPER.headline: Excellent at protecting and growing assets.
THE_KEEPER.body:
You hate risk extremely. You prefer safe assets and can't stand losing principal.

This trait shines in savings, bonds, and real estate. Conversely, never touch day trading or crypto.

Your risk is not beating inflation. An appropriate level of inflation-hedge investment is necessary.
patterns: You are sensitive to principal loss.
THE_KEEPER.best_reason: Someone who adds returns on top of your safe assets.
THE_KEEPER.challenging_reason: Risk tendencies are exactly opposite, causing financial conflicts.
actions: Invest only 10% of assets in index funds.
Compare inflation rates and deposit rates.
Do a financial checkup once a year.
red_flags: Is all your wealth in deposits?
Are you failing to keep up with inflation?

THE_ANCHOR.headline: You find wealth luck in real assets like real estate.
THE_ANCHOR.body:
You are strong in visible real assets. Wealth luck opens in real estate, gold, and savings.

This trait suits long-term investment, real estate, and real assets. Conversely, it doesn't fit coins or derivatives.

The risk is missing opportunities. If you only seek safety, assets won't grow.
patterns: You are strong in long-term investment.
You are weak at capturing fast opportunities.
THE_ANCHOR.best_reason: Someone who coordinates your safe assets.
THE_ANCHOR.challenging_reason: Conflicts with people who want fast bets.
actions: Allocate 20% of assets to growth assets.
Study alternative investments besides real estate.
Rebalance your portfolio once a year.
red_flags: Are all your assets concentrated in real estate?
Are you ignoring new investment opportunities?

THE_CULTIVATOR.headline: Honest labor and steady accumulation create wealth.
THE_CULTIVATOR.body:
You don't believe in luck. You believe in faithful savings and the power of compounding.

This trait shines in installment investments, pensions, and long-term deposits. Conversely, never touch speculative investments.

The risk is lending money to acquaintances. Lending money loses both money and relationships.
patterns: You believe in the power of compounding.
You are weak to acquaintances' requests.
THE_CULTIVATOR.best_reason: Someone who understands your faithfulness and grows together.
THE_CULTIVATOR.challenging_reason: Conflicts with people who want fast returns.
actions: Invest in installments via automatic transfer every month.
Don't lend money to acquaintances.
Sign up for a pension savings account.
red_flags: Have you lent money to acquaintances and not gotten it back?
Are you postponing installment investments?

THE_BLADE.headline: You make profits with decisive investments.
THE_BLADE.body:
Your cut-loss and take-profit are fast. You logically analyze market trends and make decisions.

This trait shines in stocks, futures, and trading. Conversely, it's dangerous for emotional investing or coins.

The risk is leverage (debt investment). Big losses follow big profits. Never use leverage.
patterns: You have strong conviction in your judgment.
THE_BLADE.challenging_reason: If both are aggressive, recovery in a crisis is hard.
actions: Never use leverage.
Keep 70% of your portfolio in safe assets.
Write a trading journal.
red_flags: Have you suffered big losses from debt investment?
Are you making emotional trades?

THE_GEM.headline: Invest in valuable objects and scarce assets.
THE_GEM.body:
You have an excellent sense of beauty and scarcity. Wealth luck opens in luxury goods, art, and premium real estate.

This trait suits art, watches, wine, and premium real estate investment. Conversely, it doesn't fit low-priced day trading.

The risk is confusing hobbies and investments. Separate emotional consumption and investment.
THE_GEM.best_reason: Someone who understands your taste and manages your finances.
THE_GEM.challenging_reason: If both have severe emotional spending, bankruptcy.
actions: Separate hobby and investment budgets.
Get expert appraisal for art/watches.
Decide emotional spending after 24 hours.
red_flags: Are you consuming while saying 'this is investment'?
Are you buying and selling based on emotion?

THE_DEEP.headline: You are a strategist who buys when others don't know and sells when they do.
THE_DEEP.body:
You analyze the structure of the market. You quietly move when the crowd is excited and boldly when the crowd is in fear.

This trait shines in value investing, long-term investing, unlisted stocks, and real estate.

The risk is missing the timing due to falling into analysis. Set a decision deadline.
patterns: It takes a long time to decide.
THE_DEEP.best_reason: Someone who puts your analysis into action.
THE_DEEP.challenging_reason: If both only analyze, you miss opportunities.
actions: Set a decision deadline.
Finish analysis within 3 days.
Find an execution partner.
red_flags: Have you missed opportunities while analyzing?
Are you continuously postponing decisions?

THE_SPRING.headline: You trust your intuition and respond flexibly.
THE_SPRING.body:
You instinctively read the flow of money. You have the power to sense opportunities others can't see.

This trait shines in short-term investing, trading, and capturing business opportunities.

The risk is falling for the tricks of people around you. If you are not sure, firmly refuse.
patterns: You are weak to the tricks of those around you.
THE_SPRING.challenging_reason: If both are impulsive, you collapse in a crisis.
actions: Always get expert verification before big investments.
Decide on friends' investment advice after 3 days.
Automatically save 10% of income.
red_flags: Have you suffered losses from friends' tricks?
Are you skipping verification trusting only intuition?
